pointcloud_icp_rigid_registration.name: pointcloud_icp_rigid_registration
pointcloud_icp_rigid_registration.description: Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm aligning two unorganized 3D point clouds with robust Tukey loss weighting to filter noisy scan outliers.

navmesh_recast_baking_validator.name: navmesh_recast_baking_validator
navmesh_recast_baking_validator.description: Generates and audits Recast 3D navigation meshes for autonomous agents, checking maximum slope climbing, step-height clearance, and unreachable islands.

robot_arm_inverse_kinematics_ccd.name: robot_arm_inverse_kinematics_ccd
robot_arm_inverse_kinematics_ccd.description: Cyclic Coordinate Descent (CCD) and FABRIK solver computing 6-DOF robotic manipulator joint angles with strict joint-angle limit enforcement.

lidar_ground_plane_ransac_filter.name: lidar_ground_plane_ransac_filter
lidar_ground_plane_ransac_filter.description: RANSAC plane segmentation isolating ground terrain from foreground obstacles and vehicles in dense unorganized LIDAR point clouds.

camera_intrinsics_projection_matrix.name: camera_intrinsics_projection_matrix
camera_intrinsics_projection_matrix.description: Computes 4x4 perspective and orthographic camera projection matrices, mapping FOV, focal length, sensor dimensions, and near/far clipping planes.
